semantics: Three lines: n k (1<=n<=100000, 1<=k<=min(n,9), k divides n); m=n/k values a_i with 1<=a_i<10^k; m digits b_i in 0..9 (exponents attested from the public English statement). A block is the k-digit zero-padded integer, so its first digit is 0 for values below 10^(k-1). Unique integer: product over blocks of (multiples of a_i in [0,10^k-1]) minus (multiples in [b_i*10^(k-1),(b_i+1)*10^(k-1)-1]), modulo 10^9+7. Floor-difference oracle; independently checked by per-leading-digit ceil counts, zero-padded multiple enumeration for every a_i,b_i with k<=4, and literal phone-number enumeration n<=4.
